unitOnlyEvidence.proves: jsdom only: choosing a model updates the closed trigger text to provider/model and sends PUT /api/ai/agents with the new ModelRef; queued PUTs send the newest doc; a held first PUT does not get overwritten.
unitOnlyEvidence.notProof: not a native browser run; no real network, no real render, no reload readback.

sourceBehavior.uiWiring: AgentsSection: pending ref is the single source for serialized PUTs; view = pending.current ?? data; mutate() writes pending, bumps render, then flush() PUTs the newest snapshot. The closed trigger is refId(view.director.model), so it is expected to change immediately, including while the PUT is in flight.
sourceBehavior.saveModel: Autosave only. There is no Save button; the only in-flight affordance is the status line rendered only while saving.
sourceBehavior.failure: On error: pending cleared, GET invalidated, trigger reverts; capability_missing/unknown_model -> inline field message; other errors -> toast. 422 body: {error, reason, need?, field?, model?}.
sourceBehavior.caveat: Whether the real Combobox re-renders its closed display immediately when parent value changes in the browser is exactly what is unproven.

safeQAContract.authorization: admin only: machineAdminOnly returns write for path == /api/ai/agents (GET is allowed for any logged-in user)
bodyRules: Send the COMPLETE doc: a missing ModelRef becomes {provider:"",model:""} and fails validation; missing fallback arrays become [].
Only fields carried by aiAgentsWire are accepted; the response is the normalized doc.
Normalization: if artist.fallbackOn && drawFallback is empty, the server fills drawFallback with the other subscription draw source (chatgpt<->grok) and persists that normalized value.
validation: director.model must exist in that provider catalog AND be in provider.selected AND carry text cap.
artist.promptModel must be selected and carry vision cap.
artist.draw and artist.drawFallback[] must be selected and carry image cap.
effort must be auto|low|medium|high else 422 reason invalid_effort.
unknown provider/model or unselected model -> 422 reason unknown_model {model}.
missing capability -> 422 reason capability_missing {need, field, model}.
when composition-root executors are wired (wire_ai.go), a ref with no executor -> 422 reason no_executor {need, field, model}.
safeQAContract.response: 200 application/json with the normalized AiAgents doc
sideEffects: OnAgentsChanged: composition root re-runs exec.configure (rebuilds the stored chain; errors printed, not returned)
no provider, model or receipt rows are written
readback: full document reload -> agents screen trigger shows the new refs
the closed trigger text must change before the PUT resolves

store.ddl: settings(key text PRIMARY KEY, value jsonb NOT NULL, updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())  [migrations/00001_base.sql]
store.write: INSERT INTO settings (key, value) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = $2, updated_at = now()  [queries/settings.sql SetSetting]
store.scope: GLOBAL machine/role config (one row, not per project/clone); GET falls back to domain.DefaultAgentModels() when the key is absent
store.rawVsNormalized: Agents() normalizes for the response but does NOT persist normalization. A stored doc may therefore differ byte-wise from GET (e.g. fallbackOn true with empty drawFallback). For a true CAS restore, snapshot the RAW settings.value (and found), not only the GET body.

additionalWriteRequired.server: aiconn.Service.PatchProvider -> checkSelectedUsable -> AIConnStore.SetSelected -> UPDATE ai_providers SET selected=$2, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1
additionalWriteRequired.constraints: adding is allowed; removing a model still referenced by agents is blocked (in_use) - so restore agents before restoring selected

harnessSteps: 1. Read-only preflight: GET /api/ai/providers; GET /api/ai/agents; GET /api/ai/providers/<chatgpt id>/models?q=<target>. Confirm target is in the catalog, not yet selected, and carries the needed cap (text for director, vision for promptModel).

2. Controller CAS out of band: snapshot settings key ai.agents (found + raw value) and ai_providers.selected for the provider (and updated_at values if exact-timestamp restore is required). No SQL/API in this audit; the parent owns this step.

3. Browser allowlist: allow GET/HEAD everywhere; allow exactly PUT /api/ai/agents and (if needed) PATCH /api/ai/providers/<id> with the expected body; block and assert every other write, especially /models/check, /login, /test and inference routes.

4. If a second selected model is required: PATCH selected first, then GET provider to confirm the new id is in selected (persistence of selection is itself currently unproven - include a reload check).
5. Open #/settings?section=agents, hold the PUT with page.route (continue after the assertion), click the director Model trigger and choose the target option.

6. Assert BEFORE releasing the PUT: the closed trigger text contains the new provider/model and the current selection marker; the picker closes; no Save button exists; the saving status is shown while in flight. This is the immediate-update assertion the user reported as broken.
7. Release -> assert PUT 200, body echoes the requested refs, exactly one PUT; GET /api/ai/agents readback; full reload; assert the trigger still shows the new refs from GET.
8. Negative: assert no other write, no model call, no image receipt; then rollback: PUT the prior agents doc first, then PATCH selected back to the prior ids, then GET equality and reload.

agentsBefore: updated_at (DB timestamp; not restorable through HTTP because the upsert always sets now())
agentsRestore: If found=true: PUT the prior raw doc; verify GET equals the prior GET and the raw value matches where the prior raw was already normalized; PUT necessarily rewrites updated_at.

If found=false: the row did not exist and GET served DefaultAgentModels; there is NO HTTP route to delete a settings key, so exact absence restore requires SQL DELETE FROM settings WHERE key='ai.agents'. Without SQL, PUT DefaultAgentModels() leaves an equivalent default row (behaviour equal, presence differs).
Because Agents() normalizes only in memory, a PUT restore using the GET body may persist drawFallback that the raw row lacked; use the raw snapshot if byte equality matters.
providerBefore: ai_providers.selected for that provider id (jsonb array)
ai_providers.updated_at (DB now(), not restorable via HTTP)
cleanupFields.providerRestore: After agents are restored, PATCH /api/ai/providers/<id> {selected: prior array}; verify GET provider.selected equals prior. Do not PATCH selected back first: removing a model still referenced by agents is blocked (in_use).
cleanupFields.noModelRowTouch: Using an existing catalog model avoids models/check, so no ai_models upsert and no manual flag needs restoring. If models/check were used, its ai_models row (manual=true plus adapter caps/context/prices) would need its own CAS restore (132 manifest already models this).
extraSideEffects: SSE invalidation and executor reconfiguration are transient; no persisted cleanup needed
queue/pipeline jobs are untouched by a PUT agents; provider-catalog audit already asserts job/agent snapshot equality for its own writes

riskNotes: Do not reuse 132 as agent-selection proof: it writes only POST /models/check and a local draft, never PUT /api/ai/agents.
The PUT is global: it changes the model chain for future pipeline steps machine-wide; run only against the isolated QA HOME/DB.
A capability_missing/unknown_model 422 is a truthful negative, not a UI pass; if the harness hits it, stop and report rather than retrying with a different model.
